title: Zaalouk (Moroccan Smoky Aubergine and Tomato Salad)
summary: Grill-charred aubergine cooked down with tomatoes, garlic, cumin, paprika and cayenne in olive oil, then finished with fresh coriander and lemon juice.
equipment: rimmed baking tray lined with foil

ingredients.item: extra-virgin olive oil, plus extra to serve
fine sea salt or table salt
lemon juice, plus extra to serve

steps.title: Char the aubergines
steps.text: Heat the grill (broiler) to high with a shelf about 25 cm below. Prick each aubergine about 6 times, put them on the tray and grill for about 25 min, turning halfway, until the skins are shrivelled and darkened and the flesh is very soft. Cool for 10 min, then peel and chop the flesh. Charring the skins gives the dish its smoky flavour.

steps.title: Bloom the spices
steps.text: Heat 2 tbsp oil in the pan over medium heat. Add the garlic, cumin, paprika, cayenne, salt and sugar and stir for about 1 min until fragrant.

steps.title: Simmer
steps.text: Add the tomatoes and cook for about 10 min, stirring, until thickened. Stir in the aubergine and the remaining 2 tbsp oil and cook for 10-15 min more, mashing with the spoon, until thick and jammy with no watery liquid left.

steps.title: Finish
steps.text: Take the pan off the heat and stir in 2 tbsp coriander and the lemon juice. Serve warm or at room temperature, drizzled with oil and scattered with the remaining coriander, with bread.

tips: You can char the aubergines directly over a gas flame for even more smoke.
Taste and add more lemon or cayenne to your liking.
Serve as a dip, a side for grilled meats, or as part of a spread of salads.
storage: Refrigerate covered up to 4 days. Serve at room temperature or warm gently. Cool leftovers in a shallow container and refrigerate within 2 hours (within 1 hour on a day above 32°C).
